<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>ClearPath — check your transfer requirements</title>
<meta name="description" content="A free, student-built tool for California community college students to check their coursework against a specific transfer pathway — no login, no upload, nothing saved.">
<meta property="og:title" content="ClearPath — check your transfer requirements">
<meta property="og:description" content="Pick your pathway, enter your courses, see what's left. Built by a transfer student, for transfer students.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1B4965">
<link rel="icon" type="image/jpeg" href="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Serif+4:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --paper:#FFFFFF;
    --paper-raised:#F4F9FC;
    --ink:#1B2530;
    --ink-soft:#5C6B78;
    --rule:#CFE1EC;
    --sky:#2E7AAE;
    --sky-dim:#E4F1F9;
    --sky-deep:#1B4965;
    --teal:#2E7D46;
    --teal-dim:#DCEBDF;
    --amber:#96760A;
    --amber-dim:#F2E7BE;
    --rust:#B23A2E;
    --rust-dim:#F5DCD8;
    --focus:#2E7AAE;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  h1,h2,h3{
    font-family:'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;
    font-weight:600;
    margin:0;
  }
  a{color:var(--sky);}
  .wrap{
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:40px 24px 96px;
  }

  /* ---- Giant site header + tabs ---- */
  .site-header{
    background:var(--sky-deep);
    color:#FFFFFF;
    padding:36px 24px 0;
  }
  .site-header-inner{
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .site-header h1{
    font-size:38px;
    color:#FFFFFF;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }
  .site-header .tagline{
    margin:8px 0 26px;
    color:#CFE7F5;
    font-size:15.5px;
    max-width:56ch;
  }
  .tab-row{
    display:flex;
    gap:4px;
  }
  .tab-btn{
    background:none;
    border:none;
    color:#CFE7F5;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:500;
    padding:12px 18px;
    cursor:pointer;
    border-bottom:3px solid transparent;
  }
  .tab-btn:hover{color:#FFFFFF;}
  .tab-btn.active{
    color:#FFFFFF;
    border-bottom:3px solid var(--paper);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }
  .tab-btn:focus{outline:2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset:-2px;}

  .page{display:none;}
  .page.active{display:block;}

  .developer-credit{
    margin-top:0;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-style:italic;
  }
  .affil-note{
    margin-top:14px;
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    border-left:3px solid var(--rule);
    padding-left:10px;
  }
  section{margin-bottom:36px;}
  h2.section-title{font-size:22px; margin-bottom:12px;}
  .step-label{
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .step-num{
    font-family:'Source Serif 4', serif;
    font-style:italic;
    color:var(--sky);
    font-size:15px;
  }
  .step-label h2{font-size:19px; color:var(--ink);}

  .field-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap:12px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
  }
  @media (max-width:600px){ .field-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  label{
    display:block;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    margin-bottom:5px;
  }
  select, input, textarea{
    width:100%;
    font-family:inherit;
    font-size:14.5px;
    padding:9px 10px;
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    border:1px solid var(--rule);
    border-radius:3px;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  textarea{resize:vertical; min-height:90px;}
  select:focus, input:focus, textarea:focus, button:focus{
    outline:2px solid var(--focus);
    outline-offset:1px;
  }

  .catalog-note{
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    border:1px dashed var(--rule);
    padding:10px 12px;
    border-radius:3px;
    margin-top:8px;
  }

  table{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    margin-top:10px;
    font-size:14px;
  }
  th{
    text-align:left;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:12px;
    padding:6px 8px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--sky);
  }
  td{
    padding:8px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);
    vertical-align:middle;
  }
  td input, td select{padding:6px 8px; font-size:13.5px;}
  .rm-btn{
    background:none;
    border:1px solid var(--rule);
    color:var(--rust);
    font-size:12px;
    padding:5px 9px;
    border-radius:3px;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .rm-btn:hover{background:var(--rust-dim);}

  .add-row-btn{
    margin-top:10px;
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    border:1px solid var(--sky);
    color:var(--sky);
    font-size:13.5px;
    padding:8px 14px;
    border-radius:3px;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .add-row-btn:hover{background:var(--sky-dim);}

  .primary-btn{
    background:var(--sky);
    color:#FFFFFF;
    border:none;
    font-size:14.5px;
    padding:11px 18px;
    border-radius:3px;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
  }
  .primary-btn:hover{background:#256691;}

  .verify-strip{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    border:1px solid var(--rule);
    padding:9px 12px;
    border-radius:3px;
    margin-top:14px;
    gap:10px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }

  .req-item{
    border:1px solid var(--rule);
    border-left-width:5px;
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    padding:14px 16px;
    border-radius:3px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .req-item.met{border-left-color:var(--teal);}
  .req-item.progress{border-left-color:var(--amber);}
  .req-item.missing{border-left-color:var(--rust);}

  .req-top{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:12px;
    align-items:baseline;
  }
  .req-title{font-size:15px; font-weight:600;}
  .req-tag{
    font-size:11.5px;
    padding:3px 8px;
    border-radius:20px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .req-tag.met{background:var(--teal-dim); color:var(--teal);}
  .req-tag.progress{background:var(--amber-dim); color:var(--amber);}
  .req-tag.missing{background:var(--rust-dim); color:var(--rust);}
  .req-detail{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:6px;}
  .req-matched{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:6px; font-style:italic;}

  .summary-note{
    font-size:13.5px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    border-left:3px solid var(--sky);
    padding:12px 14px;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }

  footer.site-footer{
    border-top:2px solid var(--sky);
    padding-top:16px;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }

  .hero-divider{
    width:100vw;
    margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);
    background:var(--sky);
    color:#FFFFFF;
    padding:56px 24px;
    margin-bottom:36px;
    text-align:left;
  }
  .hero-divider-inner{
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .hero-divider h2{
    color:#FFFFFF;
    font-size:34px;
    line-height:1.2;
    max-width:20ch;
  }
  .hero-divider p{
    margin:14px 0 0;
    font-size:15.5px;
    max-width:52ch;
    color:#E4F1F9;
  }
  .hero-divider .eyebrow{
    font-size:12.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    color:#CFE7F5;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }

  /* ---- Home page blocks ---- */
  .about-block p{font-size:15px; margin:0 0 12px; max-width:64ch;}
  .instructions-list{padding-left:20px; margin:0; font-size:14.5px;}
  .instructions-list li{margin-bottom:8px;}

  .feedback-block{
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    border:1px solid var(--rule);
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:22px 22px 20px;
    margin-top:8px;
  }
  .feedback-block h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .feedback-block p{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0 0 14px; max-width:60ch;}
  .feedback-status{
    font-size:13.5px;
    color:var(--teal);
    margin-top:10px;
    display:none;
  }
  .field-stack > div{margin-bottom:12px;}

  .hidden{display:none;}

  .skip-link{
    position:absolute;
    left:-999px;
    top:auto;
    background:var(--sky-deep);
    color:#FFFFFF;
    padding:10px 16px;
    border-radius:0 0 4px 0;
    font-size:14px;
    z-index:100;
  }
  .skip-link:focus{
    left:0;
    top:0;
  }

  @media print{
    .site-header .tab-row, .hero-divider, .brand-watermark, .feedback-block,
    .affil-note, footer.site-footer, .add-row-btn, .rm-btn, .skip-link,
    #page-home, #page-about { display:none !important; }
    .site-header{background:#FFFFFF !important; color:#000 !important; padding:0 0 12px;}
    .site-header h1{color:#000 !important;}
    .site-header .tagline{display:none;}
    #page-check{display:block !important;}
    body{background:#FFFFFF;}
  }

  /* ---- About page ---- */
  .profile-row{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:16px;
    margin-bottom:22px;
  }
  .profile-initials{
    width:56px;
    height:56px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--sky-dim);
    color:var(--sky-deep);
    font-family:'Source Serif 4', serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:20px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .profile-name{font-size:16px; font-weight:600;}
  .profile-role{font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .origin-story p{font-size:15px; margin:0 0 14px; max-width:64ch;}

  .brand-watermark{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    padding:36px 24px 44px;
    opacity:0.9;
  }
  .brand-watermark img{display:block; margin:0 auto;}
  .wm-caption{
    font-size:8px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    opacity:0.65;
    letter-spacing:0.01em;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a href="#page-home" class="skip-link">Skip to main content</a>

<header class="site-header">
  <div class="site-header-inner">
    <h1>ClearPath</h1>
    <p class="tagline">An independent, student-built tool for checking transfer coursework against a specific community-college-to-university pathway.</p>
    <div class="tab-row">
      <button class="tab-btn active" id="tab-home" onclick="showPage('home')">Home</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" id="tab-check" onclick="showPage('check')">ClearPath Check</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" id="tab-about" onclick="showPage('about')">About us</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" id="tab-resources" onclick="showPage('resources')">Resources</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ============= HOME PAGE ============= -->
<div id="page-home" class="page active">
  <div class="hero-divider">
    <div class="hero-divider-inner">
      <div class="eyebrow">HOME</div>
      <h2>A clearer way to track your transfer.</h2>
      <p>One pathway, real requirements, plain answers — built by a student who's doing this too.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wrap">

    <section class="about-block">
      <h2 class="section-title">What ClearPath is</h2>
      <p>ClearPath is a self-check tool for California community college students working toward a transfer. Pick your community college, your target university, and your major, enter the courses you've taken or are taking, and see which requirements for that specific pathway are met, in progress, or not yet started.</p>
      <p>It's built for students who want a quick, honest read on where they stand between visits to a counselor — not a replacement for one.</p>
      <div class="developer-credit">Developed by Noah Chung</div>
    </section>

    <section>
      <h2 class="section-title">Before you use it</h2>
      <div class="affil-note">
        This is a mockup, not a live service. ClearPath is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to ASSIST.org, the California Community Colleges Chancellor's Office, the University of California, or the California State University system. Course and requirement data shown here is sample data for design purposes only.
      </div>
      <div class="affil-note" style="margin-top:10px;">
        ClearPath does not confirm your transfer eligibility, TAG status, ADT status, GPA standing, or admission chances. It compares self-reported coursework against a stored copy of one articulation agreement, which may be incomplete or out of date. Always confirm your plan with ASSIST.org, your target university, and your academic counselor before making enrollment decisions.
      </div>
      <div class="affil-note" style="margin-top:10px;">
        No transcripts or official records are collected here. Every course entry is typed in by you, nothing is uploaded, and nothing is saved once you close this page.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section>
      <h2 class="section-title">How to use it</h2>
      <ol class="instructions-list">
        <li>Go to the <strong>ClearPath Check</strong> tab above.</li>
        <li>Select your community college, transfer destination, major, and the catalog year you're following.</li>
        <li>Add each course you've completed, are currently taking, or plan to take.</li>
        <li>Read the results: green means met, yellow means in progress or planned, red means no matching course entered yet.</li>
        <li>Take what you find to your counselor — this tool doesn't replace that conversation, it just gives you something concrete to bring to it.</li>
      </ol>
    </section>

    <footer class="site-footer">
      ClearPath — built by a community college student aiming to transfer, for other students doing the same.
    </footer>

  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============= ABOUT PAGE ============= -->
<div id="page-about" class="page">
  <div class="wrap">
    <section>
      <h2 class="section-title">About us</h2>
      <div class="profile-row">
        <div class="profile-initials">NC</div>
        <div>
          <div class="profile-name">Noah Chung</div>
          <div class="profile-role">Founder, ClearPath — community college student, transfer applicant</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="origin-story">
        <p>My journey into pursuing an education in computer science began with curiosity and a desire to build something meaningful.</p>
        <p>Starting at community college gave me the opportunity to build that foundation from the ground up. Instead of seeing it as a limitation, I saw it as a starting point. I began teaching myself programming, machine learning, and AI while working toward becoming a stronger student and building a future I could be proud of.</p>
        <p>My goal is to transfer to a university where I can further my education in computer science, and share this tool with others who share the same goal of transferring to a four-year university.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section>
      <div class="feedback-block">
        <h3>Help build this</h3>
        <p>ClearPath is a work in progress, built by one student, for other students. If something's wrong, confusing, or missing, say so here — this is meant to be a shared workspace, not a finished product handed down from above.</p>
        <div class="field-stack">
          <div>
            <label for="fb-message">Your suggestion or comment</label>
            <textarea id="fb-message" placeholder="e.g. This pathway is missing a requirement, or this label is confusing..."></textarea>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label for="fb-email">Your email (optional, if you'd like a reply)</label>
            <input type="email" id="fb-email" placeholder="you@example.com">
          </div>
        </div>
        <button class="primary-btn" id="fb-submit">Send feedback</button>
        <div class="feedback-status" id="fb-status">Thanks — this is a front-end mockup, so nothing was actually sent yet. In the live version, this would go straight to Noah.</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="site-footer">
      ClearPath — built by a community college student aiming to transfer, for other students doing the same.
    </footer>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============= CLEARPATH CHECK PAGE ============= -->
<div id="page-check" class="page">
  <div class="hero-divider">
    <div class="hero-divider-inner">
      <div class="eyebrow">CLEARPATH CHECK</div>
      <h2>See exactly what's left for your transfer.</h2>
      <p>Pick your pathway, enter your courses, and get a plain answer on what's done and what isn't.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="wrap">

    <section>
      <div class="step-label"><span class="step-num">1</span><h2>Select the pathway you're checking</h2></div>
      <div class="field-row">
        <div>
          <label for="ccc">Community college</label>
          <input type="text" id="ccc" list="ccc-list" placeholder="Start typing or scroll the list...">
          <datalist id="ccc-list"></datalist>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="dest">Transfer destination</label>
          <input type="text" id="dest" list="dest-list" placeholder="Start typing or scroll the list...">
          <datalist id="dest-list"></datalist>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="major">Major</label>
          <input type="text" id="major" list="major-list" placeholder="Start typing or scroll the list...">
          <datalist id="major-list"></datalist>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="field-row" style="grid-template-columns:1fr;">
        <div>
          <label for="catalog">Catalog year you're following</label>
          <select id="catalog">
            <option>2025–2026</option>
            <option>2024–2025</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="catalog-note">
        Destination names are tagged by transfer-guarantee type: <strong>(UC – TAG eligible)</strong> for the 6 UC campuses offering the Transfer Admission Guarantee, <strong>(UC – no TAG)</strong> for the 3 that don't (Berkeley, Los Angeles, San Diego — still valid transfer destinations via regular admission), and <strong>(CSU – ADT)</strong> for CSU campuses reachable through an Associate Degree for Transfer. Requirements change by catalog year — if you're not sure which year applies to you, check with your counselor.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section>
      <div class="step-label"><span class="step-num">2</span><h2>Enter the courses you've taken or are taking</h2></div>
      <table id="course-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width:26%">School</th>
            <th style="width:16%">Course code</th>
            <th style="width:14%">Term</th>
            <th style="width:16%">Status</th>
            <th style="width:12%">Grade</th>
            <th style="width:10%">Units</th>
            <th></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="course-body"></tbody>
      </table>
      <button class="add-row-btn" id="add-row">+ Add a course</button>
    </section>

    <section>
      <div class="step-label"><span class="step-num">3</span><h2>What's left for this pathway</h2></div>

      <div class="summary-note" id="summary-note" aria-live="polite"></div>

      <div id="req-list" aria-live="polite"></div>

      <div class="verify-strip">
        <span>Sample requirement set last verified: <strong>Aug 14, 2025</strong> against the published articulation agreement for this catalog year.</span>
        <a href="#">View source</a>
      </div>

      <div style="margin-top:14px; display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <button class="add-row-btn" id="copy-summary-btn" type="button">Copy summary for your counselor</button>
        <button class="add-row-btn" id="download-summary-btn" type="button">Download as text file</button>
        <button class="add-row-btn" id="print-btn" type="button" onclick="window.print()">Print this page</button>
      </div>
      <div class="feedback-status" id="export-status" style="margin-top:8px;"></div>
    </section>

    <footer class="site-footer">
      ClearPath does not confirm your transfer eligibility, TAG status, ADT status, GPA standing, or admission chances. It compares self-reported coursework against a stored copy of one articulation agreement, which may be incomplete or out of date. Always confirm your plan with ASSIST.org, your target university, and your academic counselor before making enrollment decisions. No transcripts or official records are collected by this tool — all course entries are typed in by you and are not saved after you close this page.
    </footer>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="brand-watermark">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Rubber duck logo" width="70" height="42" style="object-fit:contain;">
  <div class="wm-caption">CC-licensed illustration</div>
</div>

<!-- ============= RESOURCES PAGE ============= -->
<div id="page-resources" class="page">
  <div class="wrap">
    <section>
      <h2 class="section-title">Official tools and sources</h2>
      <p style="font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:64ch; margin:0 0 16px;">ClearPath is meant to sit alongside these, not replace them. When in doubt, the official source wins.</p>
      <div class="req-item met" style="border-left-color:var(--sky);">
        <div class="req-title">ASSIST.org</div>
        <div class="req-detail">The official, legally authoritative source for California community college articulation agreements. If ClearPath and ASSIST ever disagree, trust ASSIST.</div>
        <div class="req-matched"><a href="https://assist.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener">assist.org</a></div>
      </div>
      <div class="req-item met" style="border-left-color:var(--sky);">
        <div class="req-title">UC Transfer Admission Planner (UC TAP)</div>
        <div class="req-detail">UC's own free tool for tracking coursework toward a UC transfer, and the required system for submitting a TAG application to one of the six participating UC campuses.</div>
        <div class="req-matched"><a href="https://uctap.universityofcalifornia.edu/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">uctap.universityofcalifornia.edu</a></div>
      </div>
      <div class="req-item met" style="border-left-color:var(--sky);">
        <div class="req-title">CSU Transfer Planner</div>
        <div class="req-detail">CSU's own free tool for tracking general education and major progress toward any of the 23 CSU campuses, including Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) pathways.</div>
        <div class="req-matched"><a href="https://www.calstate.edu/apply/transfer" target="_blank" rel="noopener">calstate.edu/apply/transfer</a></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section>
      <h2 class="section-title">Quick answers</h2>
      <div class="req-item progress">
        <div class="req-title">What's a TAG?</div>
        <div class="req-detail">A Transfer Admission Guarantee — a contract with one of six UC campuses (Davis, Irvine, Merced, Riverside, Santa Barbara, Santa Cruz) that guarantees admission if you meet its specific course, GPA, and deadline requirements. Berkeley, LA, and San Diego don't offer TAG.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="req-item progress">
        <div class="req-title">What's an ADT?</div>
        <div class="req-detail">An Associate Degree for Transfer — a specific type of associate degree (under state law SB 1440) that guarantees priority CSU admission consideration once completed, though not necessarily to your first-choice campus or major.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="req-item progress">
        <div class="req-title">What's Cal-GETC, and why does my catalog year matter?</div>
        <div class="req-detail">Cal-GETC is California's newer general-education transfer pattern, required for any student who started at a community college in Fall 2025 or later. Students who started earlier may follow an older GE pattern under catalog rights — which is exactly why ClearPath asks for your catalog year before showing results.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="req-item progress">
        <div class="req-title">My community college or major isn't listed — now what?</div>
        <div class="req-detail">Type the closest match, or use the feedback box on the About us page to flag it. This is a small, growing tool, not a complete registry yet.</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="site-footer">
      ClearPath — built by a community college student aiming to transfer, for other students doing the same.
    </footer>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ---- Tab switching ----
function showPage(name){
  document.getElementById('page-home').classList.toggle('active', name === 'home');
  document.getElementById('page-check').classList.toggle('active', name === 'check');
  document.getElementById('page-about').classList.toggle('active', name === 'about');
  document.getElementById('page-resources').classList.toggle('active', name === 'resources');
  document.getElementById('tab-home').classList.toggle('active', name === 'home');
  document.getElementById('tab-check').classList.toggle('active', name === 'check');
  document.getElementById('tab-about').classList.toggle('active', name === 'about');
  document.getElementById('tab-resources').classList.toggle('active', name === 'resources');
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

// ---- Feedback form (front-end demo only, no backend wired) ----
document.getElementById('fb-submit').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const msg = document.getElementById('fb-message').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('fb-status');
  if (!msg){
    status.textContent = 'Add a message before sending.';
    status.style.color = 'var(--rust)';
    status.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  status.textContent = "Thanks — this is a front-end mockup, so nothing was actually sent yet. In the live version, this would go straight to Noah.";
  status.style.color = 'var(--teal)';
  status.style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('fb-message').value = '';
  document.getElementById('fb-email').value = '';
});

// ---- Verified reference data ----
// California Community Colleges (116 credit-granting colleges), compiled from
// Wikipedia's "List of California Community Colleges" (sourced from CCCCO's
// official alphabetical listing). Excludes noncredit-only campuses and
// Calbright (online workforce college, not a transfer-track campus).
// Double-check against cccco.edu's official directory before real launch.
const cccList = [
"Allan Hancock College","American River College","Antelope Valley College","Bakersfield College",
"Barstow Community College","Berkeley City College","Butte College","Cabrillo College","Cañada College",
"Cerritos College","Cerro Coso Community College","Chabot College","Chaffey College","Citrus College",
"City College of San Francisco","Clovis Community College","Coalinga College","Coastline College",
"College of Alameda","College of Marin","College of San Mateo","College of the Canyons",
"College of the Desert","College of the Redwoods","College of the Sequoias","College of the Siskiyous",
"Columbia College","Compton College","Contra Costa College","Copper Mountain College",
"Cosumnes River College","Crafton Hills College","Cuesta College","Cuyamaca College","Cypress College",
"De Anza College","Diablo Valley College","East Los Angeles College","El Camino College",
"Evergreen Valley College","Feather River College","Folsom Lake College","Foothill College",
"Fresno City College","Fullerton College","Gavilan College","Glendale Community College",
"Golden West College","Grossmont College","Hartnell College","Imperial Valley College",
"Irvine Valley College","Laney College","Las Positas College","Lassen Community College",
"Lemoore College","Long Beach City College","Los Angeles City College","Los Angeles Harbor College",
"Los Angeles Mission College","Los Angeles Pierce College","Los Angeles Southwest College",
"Los Angeles Trade–Technical College","Los Angeles Valley College","Los Medanos College",
"Madera Community College","Mendocino College","Merced College","Merritt College",
"MiraCosta College","Mission College","Modesto Junior College","Moorpark College",
"Moreno Valley College","Monterey Peninsula College","Mt. San Antonio College","Mt. San Jacinto College",
"Napa Valley College","Norco College","Ohlone College","Orange Coast College","Oxnard College",
"Palo Verde College","Palomar College","Pasadena City College","Porterville College",
"Reedley College","Rio Hondo College","Riverside City College","Sacramento City College",
"Saddleback College","San Bernardino Valley College","San Diego City College","San Diego Mesa College",
"San Diego Miramar College","San Joaquin Delta College","San José City College","Santa Ana College",
"Santa Barbara City College","Santa Monica College","Santa Rosa Junior College","Santiago Canyon College",
"Shasta College","Sierra College","Skyline College","Solano Community College","Southwestern College",
"Taft College","Ventura College","Victor Valley College","West Hills College Coalinga",
"West Hills College Lemoore","West Los Angeles College","West Valley College","Woodland Community College",
"Yuba College"
];

// UC campuses — verified split by TAG participation (checked live, not from memory)
const ucTag = ["UC Davis","UC Irvine","UC Merced","UC Riverside","UC Santa Barbara","UC Santa Cruz"];
const ucNoTag = ["UC Berkeley","UC Los Angeles","UC San Diego"];

// All 23 CSU campuses, reachable via Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT / SB 1440)
const csuList = [
"CSU Bakersfield","CSU Channel Islands","CSU Chico","CSU Dominguez Hills","CSU East Bay",
"CSU Fresno","CSU Fullerton","Cal Poly Humboldt","CSU Long Beach","CSU Los Angeles",
"Cal Maritime","CSU Monterey Bay","CSU Northridge","Cal Poly Pomona","CSU Sacramento",
"CSU San Bernardino","San Diego State University","San Francisco State University",
"San José State University","Cal Poly San Luis Obispo","CSU San Marcos","Sonoma State University",
"CSU Stanislaus"
];

const majorSuggestions = [
"Computer Science","Business Administration","Biology","Psychology","Mechanical Engineering",
"Electrical Engineering","Economics","Nursing (Pre-Licensure)","English","Political Science",
"Sociology","Chemistry","Mathematics","Kinesiology","Communication Studies"
];

function fillDatalist(id, items){
  const dl = document.getElementById(id);
  dl.innerHTML = items.map(v => `<option value="${v}"></option>`).join('');
}

fillDatalist('ccc-list', cccList);
fillDatalist('dest-list', [
  ...ucTag.map(u => `${u} (UC – TAG eligible)`),
  ...ucNoTag.map(u => `${u} (UC – no TAG)`),
  ...csuList.map(c => `${c} (CSU – ADT)`)
]);
fillDatalist('major-list', majorSuggestions);

// ---- Sample requirement set (stand-in for one real, curated pathway) ----
// In a real build, each requirement's "matches" array would come from a
// manually verified articulation table, not live scraping.
const requirements = [
  {
    id: 'eng1a',
    title: 'Lower-division composition (English 1A equivalent)',
    detail: '1 course, minimum grade C, 4 units.',
    matches: ['ENGL 1A', 'ENGL1A', 'ENG 1A']
  },
  {
    id: 'math-cs1',
    title: 'Calculus I for CS majors (Math 1A equivalent)',
    detail: '1 course, minimum grade C, 4 units. Must be the calculus sequence for STEM majors, not the general-ed statistics course.',
    matches: ['MATH 1A', 'MATH1A']
  },
  {
    id: 'math-cs2',
    title: 'Calculus II for CS majors (Math 1B equivalent)',
    detail: '1 course, minimum grade C, 4 units.',
    matches: ['MATH 1B', 'MATH1B']
  },
  {
    id: 'cs1',
    title: 'Introduction to Programming (CS 1A equivalent)',
    detail: '1 course, minimum grade C, 4–5 units. Some campuses require a specific language (commonly Java or C++) — confirm before enrolling.',
    matches: ['CS 1A', 'CIS 1A', 'CS1A']
  },
  {
    id: 'cs2',
    title: 'Data Structures (CS 1B equivalent)',
    detail: '1 course, minimum grade C, 4–5 units.',
    matches: ['CS 1B', 'CIS 1B', 'CS1B']
  },
  {
    id: 'phys',
    title: 'Calculus-based Physics (Physics 4A equivalent)',
    detail: '1 course with lab, minimum grade C, 4 units.',
    matches: ['PHYS 4A', 'PHYS4A']
  }
];

let rowCount = 0;

function addRow(prefill){
  rowCount++;
  const tbody = document.getElementById('course-body');
  const tr = document.createElement('tr');
  tr.dataset.rowId = rowCount;
  tr.innerHTML = `
    <td><input type="text" class="f-school" placeholder="e.g. Sample College" value="${prefill?.school||''}"></td>
    <td><input type="text" class="f-code" placeholder="e.g. MATH 1A" value="${prefill?.code||''}"></td>
    <td><input type="text" class="f-term" placeholder="e.g. Spring 2026" value="${prefill?.term||''}"></td>
    <td>
      <select class="f-status">
        <option value="completed" ${prefill?.status==='completed'?'selected':''}>Completed</option>
        <option value="inprogress" ${prefill?.status==='inprogress'?'selected':''}>Currently enrolled</option>
        <option value="planned" ${prefill?.status==='planned'?'selected':''}>Planned, not yet enrolled</option>
      </select>
    </td>
    <td><input type="text" class="f-grade" placeholder="e.g. B+" value="${prefill?.grade||''}"></td>
    <td><input type="number" min="0" step="0.5" class="f-units" placeholder="4" value="${prefill?.units||''}"></td>
    <td><button class="rm-btn" aria-label="Remove this course row" onclick="this.closest('tr').remove(); recompute();">Remove</button></td>
  `;
  tbody.appendChild(tr);
  tr.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('input', recompute));
  tr.querySelector('select').addEventListener('change', recompute);
}

function normalize(code){
  return (code||'').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
}

function recompute(){
  const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#course-body tr')).map(tr => ({
    school: tr.querySelector('.f-school').value,
    code: normalize(tr.querySelector('.f-code').value),
    term: tr.querySelector('.f-term').value,
    status: tr.querySelector('.f-status').value,
    grade: tr.querySelector('.f-grade').value,
    units: tr.querySelector('.f-units').value
  })).filter(r => r.code);

  const reqList = document.getElementById('req-list');
  reqList.innerHTML = '';

  let metCount = 0, progressCount = 0, missingCount = 0;

  requirements.forEach(req => {
    const normMatches = req.matches.map(normalize);
    const strip = s => s.replace(/\s/g,'');
    const found = rows.find(r => normMatches.some(m => strip(r.code) === strip(m)));

    let state = 'missing';
    let note = 'No matching course entered yet.';
    if (found){
      if (found.status === 'completed'){
        state = 'met';
        note = `Matched to ${found.code}${found.school ? ' at ' + found.school : ''}${found.grade ? ', grade ' + found.grade : ''}.`;
        metCount++;
      } else if (found.status === 'inprogress'){
        state = 'progress';
        note = `Matched to ${found.code}, currently enrolled${found.term ? ' (' + found.term + ')' : ''}. Not yet counted as complete.`;
        progressCount++;
      } else {
        state = 'progress';
        note = `Matched to ${found.code}, marked as planned but not yet enrolled.`;
        progressCount++;
      }
    } else {
      missingCount++;
    }

    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = `req-item ${state}`;
    const tagLabel = state === 'met' ? 'Met' : state === 'progress' ? 'In progress' : 'Not yet entered';
    div.innerHTML = `
      <div class="req-top">
        <div class="req-title">${req.title}</div>
        <div class="req-tag ${state}">${tagLabel}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="req-detail">${req.detail}</div>
      <div class="req-matched">${note}</div>
    `;
    reqList.appendChild(div);
  });

  const summary = document.getElementById('summary-note');
  const remaining = progressCount + missingCount;
  if (rows.length === 0){
    summary.textContent = 'Add your courses above to see what this pathway still needs.';
  } else if (remaining === 0){
    summary.textContent = `All ${requirements.length} listed requirements are matched to a completed course. This reflects course completion only — it does not confirm GPA, TAG/ADT eligibility, deadlines, or admission.`;
  } else {
    summary.textContent = `${missingCount} requirement${missingCount===1?'':'s'} with no course entered, ${progressCount} in progress or planned, out of ${requirements.length} total. Details below.`;
  }
}

document.getElementById('add-row').addEventListener('click', () => addRow());

function buildSummaryText(){
  const ccc = document.getElementById('ccc').value || '(not selected)';
  const dest = document.getElementById('dest').value || '(not selected)';
  const major = document.getElementById('major').value || '(not selected)';
  const catalog = document.getElementById('catalog').value;

  const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#course-body tr')).map(tr => ({
    code: tr.querySelector('.f-code').value,
    school: tr.querySelector('.f-school').value,
    term: tr.querySelector('.f-term').value,
    status: tr.querySelector('.f-status').value
  })).filter(r => r.code);

  let lines = [];
  lines.push('ClearPath Check — summary (sample data, unofficial)');
  lines.push('Generated: ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString());
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('Community college: ' + ccc);
  lines.push('Transfer destination: ' + dest);
  lines.push('Major: ' + major);
  lines.push('Catalog year: ' + catalog);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('Courses entered:');
  if (rows.length === 0){
    lines.push('  (none entered)');
  } else {
    rows.forEach(r => {
      lines.push(`  - ${r.code} (${r.status}) — ${r.school || 'school not entered'}${r.term ? ', ' + r.term : ''}`);
    });
  }
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('Requirement status:');
  document.querySelectorAll('.req-item').forEach(div => {
    const title = div.querySelector('.req-title')?.textContent || '';
    const tag = div.querySelector('.req-tag')?.textContent || '';
    lines.push(`  [${tag}] ${title}`);
  });
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('This is sample/unofficial data. Always confirm with ASSIST.org, your target university, and your academic counselor.');
  return lines.join('\n');
}

document.getElementById('copy-summary-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const text = buildSummaryText();
  const status = document.getElementById('export-status');
  try{
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    status.textContent = 'Copied — paste it into an email or message to your counselor.';
    status.style.color = 'var(--teal)';
  } catch(e){
    status.textContent = 'Could not copy automatically — select and copy the text from the downloaded file instead.';
    status.style.color = 'var(--rust)';
  }
  status.style.display = 'block';
});

document.getElementById('download-summary-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const text = buildSummaryText();
  const blob = new Blob([text], {type:'text/plain'});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'clearpath-summary.txt';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
});

addRow({school:'Sample College', code:'MATH 1A', term:'Fall 2025', status:'completed', grade:'B', units:'4'});
addRow({school:'Sample College', code:'CS 1A', term:'Spring 2026', status:'inprogress', grade:'', units:'4'});
addRow({school:'', code:'', term:'', status:'planned', grade:'', units:''});

recompute();
</script>
</body>
</html>
